raw_response:
This plot is only 0.10 hectares — just a small corner near my house — so buying a full bag of chemical fertilizer makes no sense when one bag is for one hectare and I must save cash for my bigger fields. I will spread manure from my cattle instead, and use seed I saved from last season. My children and I can finish all the planting, weeding, and harvesting in about six days without hiring anyone.
